bullets.id: ISM Jasa September turun ke 54,9 (perkiraan 55,0, sebelumnya 55,4), tetapi indeks harganya naik ke 74,0, tertinggi sejak Juli 2022. Kombinasi aktivitas melambat dan biaya memanas ini membuat emas tertahan: Kitco mencatat spot di $4.137,70 (turun 0,05%), dan Selasa pagi emas di $4.134,47, turun 0,13%.
bullets.en: September ISM Services fell to 54.9 (forecast 55.0, prior 55.4), but its prices index rose to 74.0, the highest since July 2022. That mix of slower activity and hotter costs kept gold stuck: Kitco had spot at $4,137.70 (down 0.05%), and on Tuesday morning gold was at $4,134.47, down 0.13%.

bullets.id: Yield 10 tahun sekitar 5,31%, tertinggi sejak April 2002, dan indeks dolar di 102,18, dekat level terkuat sejak April 2025. Pasar memperkirakan sekitar 78% peluang Fed menahan suku bunga bulan ini. Brent turun 1,9% ke $100,32. Emas turun 6,14% sebulan dan sekitar 26% di bawah rekor Januari $5.608.
bullets.en: The 10-year yield is near 5.31%, the highest since April 2002, and the dollar index is at 102.18, near its strongest since April 2025. Markets price about a 78% chance the Fed holds rates this month. Brent fell 1.9% to $100.32. Gold is down 6.14% on the month and about 26% below its January record of $5,608.

bullets.id: Kitco menandai support di $4.101 dan resistance di $4.164–4.204. Agenda berikutnya: risalah FOMC Rabu, klaim pengangguran Kamis, sentimen konsumen Jumat, lalu CPI AS 14 Oktober. Risalah yang menegaskan arah pengetatan bisa membawa emas menguji $4.100 lagi.
bullets.en: Kitco marks support at $4,101 and resistance at $4,164–4,204. Next up: FOMC minutes on Wednesday, jobless claims on Thursday, consumer sentiment on Friday, then US CPI on October 14. Minutes that confirm a tightening bias could bring gold back to test $4,100.

bullets.id: Antam turun Rp10.000 ke Rp2.570.000/gram setelah naik ke Rp2.580.000 kemarin; buyback Rp2.376.000, spread Rp194.000 (sekitar 7,5%). Antam sekitar 19% di bawah rekor Rp3.168.000, lebih ringan dari koreksi emas dunia. Galeri24 Rp2.513.000 (buyback Rp2.369.000) dan UBS Rp2.536.000 (buyback Rp2.343.000).
bullets.en: Antam fell Rp10,000 to Rp2,570,000/gram after rising to Rp2,580,000 yesterday; buyback is Rp2,376,000, a Rp194,000 spread (about 7.5%). Antam is about 19% below its Rp3,168,000 record, a milder drop than global gold. Galeri24 is at Rp2,513,000 (buyback Rp2,369,000) and UBS at Rp2,536,000 (buyback Rp2,343,000).
